items.title: The total derived functor of a composition of morphisms of ringed spaces is the composition of the total derived functors
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For morphisms f: X to Y and g: Y to Z of ringed spaces, the lemma identifies the derived pushforward along the composite with the composite of the derived pushforwards as functors between the bounded below derived categories (statement lines 2272-2281). The proof applies the composition criterion for derived functors: the underlying functors compose on the nose, and the only remaining verification is that the pushforward along f sends injectives to objects acyclic for the pushforward along g, which follows from the acyclicity of pushforwards of injectives together with the description of the higher direct images (proof lines 2283-2292). The claim is H2: one criterion plus one acyclicity verification, both named, with the composability of the underlying functors reduced to a cited identity.
